basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old university student currently living in Austin, Texas. I'm majoring in computer science and have recently taken up a strong interest in technology trends, particularly in wearable tech and electric skateboards. In my spare time, I enjoy experimenting with new outfits and keeping up with sneaker culture. I'm still new to Reddit and exploring various communities. I usually browse Reddit in the late evenings, and I'm currently single.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I am a computer science student with a passion for emerging technologies. Most of my knowledge comes from academic studies and self-learning through online tutorials and tech blogs.
